scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --project apps/server/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --project apps/client/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --project packages/auth/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --project packages/db/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --project packages/ui/tsconfig.json
scripts.magic-link: docker compose logs --since 20m server | grep -A2 'Magic link'
